hero.deck: Banks make hundreds of decisions about a single customer — onboard, verify, lend, monitor, investigate — each drawing on a different system at a different moment in time. Shruhani puts one continuous intelligence layer beneath all of them: RBI-aligned, audit-defensible, built for Indian banking.
